title: Upcoming Events
bodyHtml:
Knowledge Portal Network Events

Stay up to date with webinars, conference talks, and community events from the Knowledge Portal Network (KPN) and Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE).

Upcoming Events

PanKbase Office Hours: Identifying disease-associated cellular states in the pancreas

July 9, 2026 · Webinar

Kyle Gaulton, PhD, USCD, will discuss: definition of cellular states/gene programs in a cell type by combining manual curation with computational inference of single cell data, and how input from experts can help improve these programs; approaches for determining which states/gene programs are involved in disease by combining genetic risk enrichment and genomic changes in disease; Tools for interactive visualization of states/programs in each cell type including important genes and disease risk/association.

Learn More 

Past Events

CFDE Public Webinar: Cell Maps for AI (CM4AI)

June 26, 2026 · Webinar

A deep dive session into Cell Maps for AI (CM4AI), showcasing platforms for mapping spatial cellular structures and generating AI-ready architecture assets.

View Webinar 

KPN Webinar: T1GRS Machine Learning Model for T1D Risk

June 25, 2026 · Webinar

Emily Griffin from the Gaulton Lab at UCSD presented on T1GRS: A Machine Learning Model for Determining T1D Risk and Heterogeneity, showcasing variant landscapes and profiles.

View Webinar 

KPN Webinar: June 2026 Production Release Updates

June 11, 2026 · Webinar

Catch up on the latest production release items and our newest system visualization feature, the Cell State & Program Explorer powered by LIGER.

View Webinar 

CFDE Public Webinar: Illuminating the Druggable Genome

May 29, 2026 · Webinar

This CFDE public webinar highlighted structural updates, tools, data access enhancements, and multi-omic exploration frameworks within the Druggable Genome ecosystem.

View Webinar 

CFDE Public Webinar: UniProt and Common Fund Data Ecosystem Partnership for AI-Driven Biomedical Discovery

April 24, 2026 · Webinar

UniProt presented recent work and collaborations advancing AI-driven biomedical discovery.

View Webinar 

PanKbase Office Hours: PanKgraph for Integrated Diabetes Research

April 23, 2026 · Webinar

Dr. Jie Liu and Ringo Mao presented on PanKgraph, a pancreas-focused knowledge graph framework optimized for integrated diabetes and cellular trait research.

View Webinar 

KPN Webinar: March 2026 Production Release Updates

April 9, 2026 · Webinar

Demonstration and review detailing the March 2026 Production Release updates, new data workflows, and layout refinements across network portals.

View Webinar 

CFDE Public Webinar: A Statistically Inferred Genomic Evidence Graph: Integrating the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) into the Prototype Open Knowledge Network (Proto-OKN)

March 27, 2026 · Webinar

An overview exploring user interfaces, platform integrations, and tools optimized to explore cross-program NIH workflows inside the CFDE Knowledge Center ecosystem.

View Webinar 

CFDE Public Webinar: Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues

February 27, 2026 · Webinar

Elizabeth Chun presented "Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues: Data, Analysis, and Data Portal," displaying open-access pipelines for tissue datasets (SMaHT).

View Webinar 

Inaugural PanKbase Office Hours

February 12, 2026 · Webinar

Curious about PanKbase? Learn about the resource and the Integrated Cell Browser.

View Webinar 

CFDE Public Webinar: BiomarkerKB: A Unified Knowledgebase for Biomarker Exploration and Standardized Biomarker Data

January 30, 2026 · Webinar

An exploration of tools and cross-portal access setups optimizing multi-omic query execution flows across multiple coordinated data repositories.

View Webinar 

KPN Webinar: Focus group on validating linking mouse phenotypes to human traits

January 8, 2026 · Webinar

Explore an inside look at how statistical enrichment can bridge the gap between mouse phenotypes and human traits.

Learn More

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Knowledge Portal Network Events</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />

  <!-- Typography (close match to KPN style: serif headings + clean sans body) -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Merriweather:wght@400;700&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    /* Page background & layout */
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
                   "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      background-color: #f5f5f7;
      color: #111827;
    }

    .events-page {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 2rem 1rem 3rem;
    }

  .events-page h1 {
    color: #185468 !important;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 34px;
    line-height: 1.5em;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
}

    .events-page h2 {
    color: #185468 !important;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 1.5em;
}

    .events-page-intro {
      color: #4b5563;
      font-size: 0.98rem;
    }

    .events-section-title {
    color: #185468 !important;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 1.5em;
      margin: 2rem 0 0.75rem;
    }

    .events-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Event cards */
    .event-card {
      background-color: #ffffff;
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .event-card-body {
      padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.5rem;
    }

 .event-title {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
      color: #1C3557;
    }
    
    .event-meta {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: #6b7280;
      margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Thumbnail with margin from card edges */
   .event-card-image {
  width: calc(100% - 2rem);
  margin: 0 auto 1rem auto;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: #FFFFFF;

  height: 180px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.event-card-image img {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain; /* keeps full image visible */
  display: block;
}
    .event-description {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: #374151;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      padding: 0 1.25rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .event-description p {
      margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
    }

    .event-description a {
      color: #185468;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 0.15em;
    }

    .event-card-footer {
      padding: 0 1.25rem;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    /* Buttons using HEX #185468 */
    .event-button {
   display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #185468;
      color: #fff !important;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.8em;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
    }




    .event-button:hover,
    .event-button:focus {
      background-color: #0f3a49;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .events-page {
        padding: 1.5rem 0.75rem 2.5rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
